# DeepSeek API Reference for AI Agents

> Single-file, agent-optimized reference documentation for the DeepSeek API — covering Chat Completions, Vision / Multimodal (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`), Files API, Thinking/Reasoning Mode, FIM, Tool Calling, Streaming, Context Caching, and OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatibility.

## Core Documentation

- [DeepSeek API Complete Developer Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prakhargaba007/deepseek-agent-docs/main/deepseek.md): Complete single-file documentation covering authentication, models (`deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`), endpoints, Files API, parameters, thinking mode, SDK examples, rate limits, error codes, and best practices.
